messages:
Jordan: heads up — p99 latency for model:redwood-v3 on pool-7 just spiked to ~480ms, baseline was ~210ms earlier today. seeing throughput dip too. noticed it started ~10:04 UTC.
Maia: @Jordan any recent rollouts to that pool?
Jordan: yes, we rolled redwood-v3.2 -> v3.3 to pool-7 at ~09:58 UTC. rollout was canary then gradual.
Alex: putting up perf dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/pool-7/overview :eyes:
Sophie: infra-bot shows a host noisy-tenant eviction around 10:02 on host-7a. could be related.
Ryan: quick note: tokenizer delta in v3.3 swapped to new subtokenizer that produces more long-tail subtoken sequences for conversational prompts — distribution shifted right.
Maia: that could affect batcher heuristics. our kernel selector uses median seqlen hint at batch formation time, right?
Alex: correct. current hint policy: pick kernel by median(seq_lengths) in the batch, fallback to small-batch kernel if avg_batch_len < 8.
Jordan: profiler dump attached from one affected host:
```
[PROFILE] host=host-7a time=10:04:15
- kernel_select: chosen=fast-kern-v1 (optimized for short dense sequences)
- observed_seq_len_percentiles: p50=12 p75=18 p90=64 p99=312
- kvcache_evictions/sec: 18
- kernel_switches_per_min: 42
- GPU_util: 78%
- p99_latency: 482ms
```
Ryan: wow — p50=12 but p99=312. median-based selection picked the short-kernel; long tails are getting processed with wrong kernel, causing repeated reconfigs/kernel-switching and KV cache thrash.
Sophie: that explains the high kernel_switches and evictions. noisy tenant + long tails => warmup thrash.
Maia: perf-bot, can you run a quick aggregation across pool-7 for seqlen percentiles by model version?
perf-bot: aggregation started. ETA ~45s.
perf-bot: results: v3.2 p99=128, v3.3 p99=312; p50 both ~12-14.
Alex: confirmed. v3.3 tokenizer increased tail.
Jordan: immediate mitigation options?
Maia: short term: change batcher hinting to use p90 instead of median for kernel selection (reduce kernel misselect rate). Also add quick fallback rule: if kernel_switches_per_sec > 10 then force small-batch kernel for 60s.
Ryan: agree. also lower KV cache eviction aggressiveness threshold to avoid churn during transient spikes.
Sophie: can we patch canary only to pool-7? we already rolled v3.3 broadly. maybe roll v3.3 back to v3.2 for pool-7 while we test the batcher fix.
Alex: deploy note: rollback will be slower because of pinned customers on Dedicated; but pool-7 is hosted — safe to rollback the canary slice.
Jordan: action items:
- Alex: trigger canary rollback on pool-7 (if no objections) — ETA 15m
- Maia: patch batcher hinting config to p90 and add kernel-switch fallback — create CL and hot patch — ETA 30m
- Ryan: adjust kvcache eviction threshold for pool-7 hosts — ETA 20m
- Sophie: monitor p99, kernel_switches, and kv_evictions; notify if p99 not under 280ms in 30m
Alex: starting rollback now. infra-bot: kickoff rollback job #RB-1945 on pool-7.
infra-bot: rollback started for canary slice on pool-7 - job RB-1945 - 10:12 UTC
Jordan: Maia, sending profiler snippet to the CL to make it clear why p90 is better in long-tail workloads.
Maia: CL created: repo/runtime/batcher/CL#1892 — change hint->p90, add runtime guard. adding unit tests for percentile logic.
perf-bot: monitoring stream: after rollback + batcher hint -> p99 dropped to 260ms within 8 minutes on pool-7, kernel_switches_per_min down to 6, kv_evictions/sec down to 3.
Sophie: nice. keep an eye on other pools — v3.3 might affect other pools similarly depending on tenant mix.
Ryan: follow-up: propose metric-driven kernel selection: prefer pX where X chosen based on configured SLA (e.g., p90 for latency-sensitive routes, p50 for high-throughput cheap routes).
Jordan: noted. we'll post a short RFC for an adaptive hint policy and invite eng-runtime + eng-ml.
Alex: for the incident writeup: root cause = tokenizer in v3.3 increased seqlen tail; median-based kernel hinting caused misselection for tail sequences leading to kernel switching and KV-cache thrash amplified by a noisy tenant on host-7a.
Maia: mitigation = rollback canary + p90 hint + fallback guard + kvcache threshold tweak. long-term = adaptive percentile hints + per-route SLAs.
Sophie: filing postmortem stub: https://docs.internal/incidents/1945 — I'll add timeline and graphs.
Jordan: thanks team. great quick loop. :thumbsup:
Ryan: follow-up tomorrow — evaluate if tokenizer tweaks can reduce tail without hurting quality.
Alex: closing thread once perf metrics stable for 1h.
Sophie: marking as resolved in pager duty if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
__extra_note: This document is a generated realistic Slack thread for internal eng-runtime discussion about a kernel selection/batcher heuristic regression after a model/tokenizer rollout. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
